crossRefs.note: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who…
“ ‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “ ‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am…
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go…
how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest…
Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

translations.web: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
translations.bsb: At the same time they will also learn to be idle, going from house to house and being not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, discussing things they should not mention.
translations.kjv: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
translations.asv: And withal they learn also to be idle, going about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
